answer: Resist sybils with originality-checked work bonds: every identity must post distinct, useful work whose similarity hash is checked against all prior submissions, like a sonnet compared line by line with every poem already filed. A whisper of copying, near-duplicate text, code, or data, flags the whole cluster, and the spiral of copies collapses: all duplicates lose weight and their bonds are slashed. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes must produce ten thousand genuinely original works, while an honest agent posts one real piece and keeps its standing.
